en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding buying the fruit. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When something is unspoilt, so there is no problem with buying it’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “About the case of buying fruits, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When it becomes something buying it is not harmful.’”
